item.title: Even mid-sprint to a secret flight, the Navy’s tech chief has a pitch for investors

item.description: Co-founder Charles Cecil says humans are better at capturing emotion and character than AI tools.

item.title: New solar panel tech could trap heat for 1,000 times longer to beat a long-standing limit in energy production
item.description: A new discovery about tin-based solar panels means the long-standing 33% limit could eventually be breached.
